passed_checks_before_failure: Empty entrypoint sentinel runs the explicit command
Missing and empty commands reject before container or volume creation
Endpoint-only creates select the requested name or ID without joining bridge
Endpoint-only peers resolve immediately on their selected network

mixed_host_requests.selectors: Names and IDs, with missing/default/host/custom network modes

finding: The fixture incorrectly required reference Docker to reject every mixed none request. This failure occurred before candidate-engine live checks.
correction: Record reference create/start statuses, running state, inspected endpoint settings and interfaces for accepted mixed-none requests. Keep the candidate's strict HTTP 400 and absent-container/absent-volume assertions. Run the Docker reference fixture before engine builds as well as alongside live conformance.
compatibility_limit: Asagiri does not support mixed host/none endpoints. It rejects them before creating containers or volumes, rather than claiming Docker's acceptance of mixed-none requests as supported behavior.
qualification: The observed failure is retained. The revised fixture and complete candidate still require successful combined-source CI; compilation or recorded reference outcomes alone do not qualify Asagiri.
